a.text: They say there's gonna be another attack in about half an hour. You want some water?
Never mind. Look how tense you are. You'd just throw it up anyway... Breathe, breathe... Relax... Where are you from, girl?
Columbia, huh...? Ever heard of Davistown?

No? That's a shame. It's a pretty neat place. Its route takes it around the eastern forests, and the winters are long and cold, but its plate is home to a mine. Keeps its core's energy tower burning the whole time.
Just the heat generated from that keeps everyone warm all winter.

It can get pretty hot indoors, but it's also cold outside, so no matter where you go, as soon as you open the door you get puffs of white steam gushing out toward you. Which condenses on your eyelashes like teardrops.
You have to wipe them off quick, or the kids inside will laugh at you. But that's okay. That's when you fight back. Lift 'em by the armpits and toss them into the thick snowdrifts outside.
Now you get to laugh at all the snow on their faces.
Yeah, it's a great place. Everyone wants to go see it for themselves. And I...
I really want to go back and have a look, too.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hfff—How is it so damn cold here? I don't get it!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: How the hell does this even happen? So goddamned cold!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Get your ass inside then! If you know it's cold, why're you complaining about it with the door open?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I don't want to get the floor dirty.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You say that like you can wipe your feet on the snow... Here, hot tea.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Pff... That's hot!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...The floor's pretty dirty in the diner today, huh? If I'd known, I would've just walked in.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: We got some heavy snow. Every time someone steps inside, it just gets dirty again. I'll clean it up after closing.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: So what're you having? Beans? Bread?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What kinda choice is that?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: It's all we have. If you'd rather have nothing, suit yourself.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Can I get a little of both?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Fine, seeing how you're my first customer without a few screws loose. I'll even throw in a scoop of butter, on the house.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Helena...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Now what?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Why do you have mud on your chairs—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hey you two, this ain't your home. Put your feet down!

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: You talking to us, old man?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: *sigh*... Settle down, you two.

steps.name: Boorish Brute
steps.text: You stay out of this.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Don't be like that. Everyone's here for a hot meal. No need to get physical.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Hey, why're you taking his side?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Because I'd rather not see every little quarrel in this joint end in a knife fight.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Shut up, or I'll knife you too.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: For the love of—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Stay out of this, Helena. I'll teach these hoodlums a lesson.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Heh, your funeral!
The ruffian takes his knife and steps forward, only for a dinner knife to fly at him from the opposite side and embed itself in the ground near his feet.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: You?!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Not another inch, boy. It's late. Go home to your mommy.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Right back at you, woman—
Before he can take another step, a second knife brushes past his cheek and lodges itself in the wall behind him.
A few drops of fresh blood drip to the ground.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: My ear?!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Stop whining. It's still attached.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: But I can't promise it'll stay that way unless you scram. Now.
The restaurant's proprietor turns around and takes a cloth off the rack to start wiping the bar.
There is another knife wedged between her fingers.

steps.name: Rude Ruffian
steps.text: Shit...

steps.name: Boorish Brute
steps.text: Forget it, let's go. We can get them back for this later.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Here, your meal.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Yowch! It's hot!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You're about the only person who can burn his tongue twice in one visit.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hey, I was starving. Haven't had a good meal all day. Anyhow, don't you think we've been getting more and more of these thugs in town?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Probably because Woodrow's out searching for Miles... So they think nobody's gonna stop them.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hmph... Miles sure knows how to be a pain in the neck. He left the plate without a word to look for fuel, only to disappear without a trace. And now Woodrow's gotta go look for him.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What choice did he have? We don't have enough fuel to go around. Besides, it don't matter what he ran into. He can deal with anything, man or beast, in three seconds flat.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: But what if Woodrow's too late—

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Alright, enough yapping. Finish your bean stew.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *sigh* I'm just worried...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Here, it's my last bit of butter. Now shut your trap, will you?

steps.name: Lethargic Female Voice
steps.text: Kids, you awake?

steps.name: Lethargic Female Voice
steps.text: There may be ambushers in the forest. The recon team has gone ahead to scout the area, and if they need any fire support, we can't just be napping in the transport.

steps.name: No-Longer-Lethargic Female Voice
steps.text: So get off your butts, pick up your gear, and cover yourselves. On the count of three.

steps.name: No-Longer-Lethargic Female Voice
steps.text: Ugh, my eyes...

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's the glare from the snow.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: I'm pretty sure I gave you a reminder of what to look out for when fighting in a snowfield. Where are your sunglasses?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Guess I didn't think it through. Whatever, I'll have to make do with what I have on hand.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: How are things looking up ahead?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Patience. The situation's a little tricky right now. The snow's too thick, so it's hard to spot any enemies in hiding. It'll take some time to pinpoint their location.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: *sigh* This was supposed to be a power plant repair job, and now we've gotta clear out bandits, too? Guess I'll just think of it as charity work.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What do you say, kids?

steps.name: Blacksteel Operator
steps.text: Ready to go.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Seems my lackeys can't wait anymore, Captain. Can we get in touch with the Davistown officers?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: They said they'll send someone to meet us at the entrance to the plate, but there's not much they can do in the way of combat support outside.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Wow, such hospitality. Good to know I won't be getting lost in town, at any rate.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: It's a nearly bankrupt mining platform. We can't ask too much of them.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: They reported the power plant explosion and subsequent fuel leakage to the state government at the start of the year, but nobody cared.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: All things considered, they've dealt with it pretty well. So the pollution hasn't spread much, but the plant itself is almost beyond repair. Certainly more than the locals can handle.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hold up. The start of the year? How come they're only contacting us now?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: You think a tiny municipality has the budget for that? They never spend a dime until they're out of options.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: At the time, the plant could still barely support the platform's movements. A few months ago, it stopped working entirely. Now, I doubt it can provide its most basic function, heating.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's minus 14 degrees here...

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: And colder at night.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So, is it all bad news, or...?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Based on the map, Davistown is just up ahead. You should see it as soon as you get out of the woods.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Anything more exciting?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: ...Perfect timing. We've located all our targets. You can start clearing them out.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Lovely.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: One last thing before I hop to it. Where are Jessica and Laura? You send them somewhere?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: The enemy camp. There's a local being held captive there, without too many guards. It wasn't a good idea to send too big of a force.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Okay, gotcha. I'll clean this up ASAP.

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Hey. We've been hanging you here for an hour, old man. You thirsty? Need a sip of water?

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: If you ain't saying nothing, that means yes, right?

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: (Picks up a handful of snow from the ground)

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Here, have as much as you want. No need to thank me.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: *cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Please, let me go. I have nothing on me... *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: What're you saying? It's so boring out here in the snow, and we finally run into you! Been a while since I had some fun.

spans.text: What're you saying? It's so boring out here in the snow, and we finally run into
! Been a while since I had some fun.

steps.name: Indifferent Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Enough messing around. I'd like some peace and quiet, so hurry up and deal with him.

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: You hear that, old man? You're so loud, you're bothering my buddy here. We gotta shut you up—

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Ugh...!

steps.name: Indifferent Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: ...Freak.

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Everyone else's out ambushing the caravan, and we're stuck here guarding the camp.

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: And when they get back, they'll be loaded with loot, and we'll have to settle for the scraps. You telling me you're okay with that?

steps.name: Indifferent Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Tch... If you aren't going to, I'll take care of him myself.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Wh-What are you going to do?!

steps.name: Indifferent Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Quiet. It'll be over soon.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Indifferent Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Ngh—

steps.name: Cruel Snowfield Bandit
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Wh-Who are you?

steps.name: Blacksteel Operator
steps.text: Shh! Quiet!

steps.name: Blacksteel Operator
steps.text: I'm gonna untie you. Keep your voice down and follow me. Can you do that?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Blacksteel Operator
steps.text: This is Laura. I've secured the hostage. How are things on your end?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: All done, but...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: N-No... but my comms... *bzzt*... broke... It's fine. I can deal with it...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *bzzt*... Thanks.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: No need to thank me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *bzzt*... Okay.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I'll take the hostage to the rendezvous point. See you later.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *bzzt*... later.

steps.name: Stubborn Snowfield Rioter
steps.text: I'm taking you with me!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Coming at me head on? You're one brave fella.

steps.name: Stubborn Snowfield Rioter
steps.text: Urgh—!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That was the last one.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Reporting in, Captain. All targets neutralized.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Okay. We're getting ready to leave too. We should be rendezvousing with you in a few minutes. Wait there for Jessica and Laura—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey. Hello? What's going on over there?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's no need for comms at this distance.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You just had to come early, huh?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Someone once told me that playing pranks after combat can help alleviate stress.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Wow, you're getting better at this.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I learned from the best.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The weather here's real temperamental, huh? It was all clear just earlier, but it's already starting to fog up.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We've checked all your injuries, Mr. Miles. The bruise on your abdomen doesn't seem serious, but I suggest you visit the hospital as soon as can.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Hospital...? Davistown ain't had a hospital in a long, long time.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Uh... Good. We're heading to Davistown too. We can take you back.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: What are you folks up to there?

spans.text: What are you folks up to

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Relax, sir. We were dispatched to help the plate restart its operations.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We brought some fuel and supplies. They should be enough for the residents to last until the power plant is repaired.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: But... y'all bring any technicians?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: The plant was already on its last legs. Without any technicians, the blasted weather will kill us the moment it goes out for good.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Calm down, sir. I'm the lead technician on the team. Call me Laura. Nice to meet ya.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I'm Miles... a Davistown boiler worker.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Thank you... thank you...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So, why'd you leave the plate? It's dangerous out here.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: We're almost completely out of fuel, so I came out to try my luck... But if y'all are here to fix the plant, can we get going now?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: One second. Let me ask Jessica where she is.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Hey, Jessica? It's Laura. You done there?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *bzzt*... I'm all finished— *bzzt*...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Then hurry up and get over here—

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Hey? Jessica?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Jessica?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Laura, where are you? I'll head over right now—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Laura? Hello? Hello?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Why did the communicator have to break down now of all times...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Let me check the coordinates... Where's the camp?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How come there isn't so much as a marker? Where am I? I... I'm not lost, am I?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Calm down. Calm down... You're near Davistown. You aren't far from the plate...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I guess I'll have to wait for the wind to stop.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Brr... So cold.
Jessica breathes a sigh and puts her hand in her pocket.
Her fingers feel the velvet pouch in her bag, as well as the small, hard object inside.
She takes out the pouch and pours out its contents.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Reporting.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You, huh?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain Liskarm encountered a windstorm on her way back and hasn't been able to return to the landship. I'm standing in for her for debriefing.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Have you received the Davistown mission notice?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What about the details? Have you read it over yet?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: We will be heading to Davistown, a mining platform with a small residential area.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The platform is currently stranded in the forests of eastern Columbia due to a power plant explosion. Our mission is to repair the plant and restore the plate's mobility.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Good. If I remember correctly, the supplies were issued today. What about the follow-up arrangements?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's all it said in our orders.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Never mind... There's no harm in telling you. As soon as Davistown returns to its original route, Fort Barron will be there to tow it to a nearby nomadic city for merging and salvage.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Why are you telling me this?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Jessica, ever since you got back from Victoria, you haven't been putting in as much effort as before.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir... I'm not sure that's a fair appraisal.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I've been giving it my all in every mission, and have... fulfilled every mission objective.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Just last month, you refused an order to evacuate an area polluted with Originium dust.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: There was someone nearby who needed rescuing...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Half a year ago, during an assault operation, you violated your superior's order and specifically chose a route away from the residential areas. Your entire team almost got caught up in an unnecessary battle.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The original plan would have caused significant damage to the local residences... I... I...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: A year ago, when you had just returned from Victoria, you immediately charged into the command center. If you'd been carrying a firearm, I would've thought you were mutinying.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: S-Sorry, sir... I wasn't able to control my emotions... but hundreds of Victorian citizens were—

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I understand your anger, but have you ever considered what would've happened if we hadn't evacuated as soon as possible? If a duke were to find out that Blacksteel, a Columbian company, was in the area?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: To the countries involved, this would've sparked a 'conflict.' But to normal folks, we'd call that a 'disaster.'

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That does make sense when you put it like that, but... What does this have to do with our upcoming mission?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I'm just trying to remind you to avoid making the same mistake you made in Victoria.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The same mistake... What do you mean, exactly?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: And while you're at it, take this pouch. Give what's inside to a man from Davistown named Woodrow Bianchi.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Could you describe him at all? Like, his features or race—

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: No need. You'll know who he is the moment you see him.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir... I still don't understand. It's just a power plant repair. Why—

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Let me remind you, Jessica. You're a mercenary. This is about business, not duty.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Now go.
Jessica picks up the bullet that fell from the pouch, and holds it under the sunlight to examine it.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Rimmed cartridge, .44... There's a pattern etched into the bottom.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... It's too faint. I can't make it out.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sankta ammo... looks pretty much like the etched ammo we use at Blacksteel.
The casing is rusted, and the surface's copper has browned. Even under the direct sunlight, there is hardly any luster.
Jessica breathes a sigh and puts it back inside the pouch.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: 'Make the same mistake I made in Victoria'...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What's going on in Davistown?
Suddenly, she hears a sound that isn't the wind.
Don't move, girl.
Not unless you want a bullet through the chest.
